summary: Gold (~$4,013) is in a corrective downtrend ~28% below its January 2026 record, testing $4,000 under Fed-hike pressure; silver (~$53.7) is below its 200-day. Accumulate certified physically-backed gold (RMAU first; GLD, Albilad 9405 alternatives); hold off silver. Avoid futures-based ETFs; uncertified physical funds (AAAU, IAU, SLV) need a scholar's approval.
